## Checklist

- [ ] Only free, legal texts (publisher / author / CC / public domain)
- [ ] No keys, tokens, `.env` files or personal data (`npm run check:secrets`)
- [ ] `npm run build && npm test` pass
- [ ] New strings exist in EN, PL and RU
- [ ] Stored data: only added fields, or a migration step with a test (docs/data-and-sync.md)
